_: The Twilight Forest, from All the Mods 9's census (W4 R7, judged 2026-11-11). Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw and judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Cracked deadrock, the aurora pillar and slab and auroralized glass were not judged and are left to the rules.

Stone: deadrock and weathered deadrock are the natural rock of the Final Plateau and the highlands, and trollsteinn the natural rock of the troll caves, which no recipe makes; the rules leave all three out for having no stone word. Ice: the aurora block is the ice of the glacier, as named, on a material no rule reads.

Fluffy cloud, the floor of the cloud castles over the Highlands, is its own family (Xep, 2026-11-11: Add both families; 0.9.229, W4). Its packed ice gives the rules ice, and a config that recorded it there still wears it as cloud, as this file is heard over a line that only repeats detection. Judged by All the Mods 9's census and named here.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.20.1 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
